summary: Iter 220 P1 slice 3 — FRONTEND verification of CRM Quote Intelligence + Sage 200 export panel. With the mode-switch fix (clicking data-testid 'crm-mode-business' / Corporate) the Quotes (CPQ) tab becomes visible. End-to-end UI flow now PASSES: opened quote QT-726251, panel renders, intelligence summary visible ('1 price changed' + Suggested add-ons: Spin Studio + per-line flag '· Quoted £150.00 vs catalogue £824.42' on SKU 224B-AAA), Save meta → Validate → Status badge 'READY FOR SAGE' + report 'Ready for Sage 200 · account PULSE001 · net £300' → Export to Sage → result 'Exported · 1 lines · net £300 · VAT £60 · gross £360' + note 'Sage-ready file generated. Live posting activates once Sage 200 is connected.' All 9 expected data-testids present and functional. No JS pageerrors. Only console errors are 3rd-party CSP blocks (assets.emergent.sh, posthog, cloudflare beacon) — pre-existing, unrelated to this slice.
critical_code_review_comments: CRMQuoteSagePanel.downloadCsv swallows ALL errors as 'No export to download yet' — if the request fails for any other reason (CORS, 5xx, network), the user still sees that message. Consider distinguishing 404 from generic failure.

Suggestions block always says 'Suggested add-ons: X' even when intel.suggestions has no usable items — currently falls back to 'related items available'. UX nit: if neither accessories nor related exist on any suggestion, hide the row entirely.

useEffect calls loadIntel only on mount (quote.lines reference is stable across rerenders unless parent rebuilds quote). If user edits lines elsewhere and re-opens detail, intel may be stale. Consider passing a refresh trigger or watching quote.id.
Same pre-existing concern as backend slice: per-line VAT mixing — UI shows quote-level VAT (20%) only; if lines mix VAT rates the UI total may mismatch the CSV per-line VATCode.

success_rate.backend: n/a (skipped per request — 100% from previous run)

seed_data_creation: Test left quote QT-726251 with sage_account_ref=PULSE001, sage_default_nominal=4000, sage_status=exported, plus an export record. If a follow-up run needs a clean quote, pick a different QT-* (8 others available in the list, all DRAFT).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mode switch is critical: in 'Members' (leisure) mode the Quotes tab is hidden via MEMBERS_HIDDEN_TABS in CRMApp.js. Always click [data-testid='crm-mode-business'] right after login before looking for the Quotes tab. The quote list uses QT-XXXXXX text on cards — get_by_text(/QT-\d+/) works. After opening, scroll to [data-testid='quote-sage-panel'] (it lives below the line items + notes/approval flow).
rca of the issue: Not a bug — previous frontend iteration assumed Quotes tab was always visible. It is gated behind business mode. Fix applied in test approach (click crm-mode-business first). All Sage panel functionality verified working end-to-end including intelligence flags, validate, export, and status transitions.
